children: Greenland Energy entered into a Deed of Variation and Novation with 80 Mile to amend their farm-out joint venture for the Jameson Land Basin projects in Greenland. The deal transfers rights and obligations from subsidiary March GL to Greenland Energy, extends longstop dates for the first and second exploration wells to Dec. 31, 2028, and makes Greenland Energy solely responsible for securing and maintaining all required permits. In consideration, Greenland Energy will pay 80 Mile £500,000 in cash within five business days. Management expects the changes to consolidate control and provide additional time to progress drilling.
